\begin{lexlean}{App}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\title{Boolean}
\begin{semanticmodule}
structure{
  name: Field,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [
    {name: name, type: String},
    {name: least, type: Nat},
    {name: greatest, type: Nat},
    {name: values, type: (List String)}
  ]
}

structure{
  name: Condition,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: field, type: Nat}, {name: op, type: Nat}, {name: value, type: Nat}]
}

structure{
  name: Rule,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: conditions, type: (List Condition)}, {name: answer, type: Nat}]
}

structure{
  name: Guarantee,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [
    {name: always, type: Nat},
    {name: conditions, type: (List Condition)},
    {name: answer, type: Nat}
  ]
}

structure{
  name: Example,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: request, type: String}, {name: answer, type: String}]
}

definition{name: title, parameters: [], result: String, body: "Parking fee tier"}

definition{
  name: fields,
  parameters: [],
  result: (List Field),
  body: (cons (record Field {name := "hours", least := 0, greatest := 24, values := (nil String)}) (cons (record Field {name := "vehicle", least := 0, greatest := 2, values := (cons "car" (cons "motorcycle" (cons "truck" (nil String))))}) (nil Field)))
}

definition{
  name: answers,
  parameters: [],
  result: (List String),
  body: (cons "standard" (cons "free" (cons "premium" (nil String))))
}

definition{name: otherwise, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 0}

definition{
  name: rules,
  parameters: [],
  result: (List Rule),
  body: (cons (record Rule {conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 0, op := 4, value := 0}) (nil Condition)), answer := 1}) (cons (record Rule {conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 1, op := 4, value := 1}) (nil Condition)), answer := 1}) (cons (record Rule {conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 1, op := 4, value := 2}) (nil Condition)), answer := 2}) (cons (record Rule {conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 0, op := 2, value := 8}) (nil Condition)), answer := 2}) (nil Rule)))))
}

definition{
  name: guarantees,
  parameters: [],
  result: (List Guarantee),
  body: (cons (record Guarantee {always := 0, conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 1, op := 4, value := 1}) (nil Condition)), answer := 2}) (cons (record Guarantee {always := 1, conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 1, op := 4, value := 2}) (cons (record Condition {field := 0, op := 2, value := 0}) (nil Condition))), answer := 2}) (cons (record Guarantee {always := 0, conditions := (cons (record Condition {field := 0, op := 4, value := 0}) (nil Condition)), answer := 0}) (nil Guarantee))))
}

definition{
  name: examples,
  parameters: [],
